hook_text: Today it is raining in Upington. Does that mean Upington has a wet climate?
clip_script: Upington, a school weather station. Monday: hot and sunny. Tuesday: windy. Wednesday: a rare thunderstorm. That is weather, what the air is doing today. But records over thirty years show that Upington gets very little rain and has hot summers. That is climate, the usual pattern of weather over many years. Weather is your mood today. Climate is your personality.
visual_style: Whiteboard school weather station with a thermometer, rain gauge and wind vane, then a calendar flipping through many years to build up a climate graph.
mood: Curious and bright, like a science experiment.
pacing: Quick daily readings, then a slow zoom out to many years of records.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and keep your own weather diary for one week.
